copy.curiosityHook: What happened to Jack Jefferson in Cairo, and how deep does the conspiracy go once OSS 117 begins asking questions?
copy.description: In 1955, French secret agent OSS 117 heads to Cairo to look into the mysterious disappearance of his fellow operative and close friend Jack Jefferson, quickly blundering into a dense web of international intrigue.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-moving, light, and exciting retro espionage comedy that delivers brisk fun without heavy emotional drag.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Michel Hazanavicius, this stylish action-comedy combines globe-trotting 1950s espionage with quick, witty humor and dynamic mid-century intrigue.

allowedMaterial: Protagonist Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath / OSS 117
Disappearance of fellow spy and best friend Jack Jefferson
excludedMaterial: Third-act action set pieces and climax
Final fate of OSS 117 and mission outcome
